Sedona Wine Tours has three ways to do it:
• Wine Tours of Sedona: private, all-inclusive and personalized to your palate
• SIP Sedona: social small-group tours on set Verde Valley itineraries
• Sedona Wine Adventures: private and flexible, pay only for the tastings you want, and dogs are welcome
